$description: Spacing — APOLLO SDS (4px-normalised). The incumbent pre-normalisation scale is parked as a sibling at tokens/_spacing-hsbc-general.json (still live for HSBC-general). Semantic tokens: gap/* (fixed + responsive) and padding/* (responsive/fixed). SUPERSEDES the old space-0..12 / R-token tables. Fixed tokens collapse to a single $value; responsive give scale-1/2/3.
